finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = ''
---select @strFinding = '1=1' set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + @strDetailKey if @@admin = 0 set @strKey = @strKey + ' and exists(select 1 from kbnguoiduyet y where y.user_id = @@userId and y.status = 1 and y.loai = 1 and a.ma_nt = y.ma_nt and (y.tien = 0 or a.t_tt_nt <= y.tien))' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join s61 s61 on a.id_dh = s61.id', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh,c.dien_thoai, s61.so_job, (s61.ma_ct+s61.so_ct) ma_job_ct1, (s61.ma_job+s61.so_job) ma_job_ct2', '@@key',@strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

dir.script:
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case @xstatus when 1 then 5 when 5 then 1 else 5 end --else 9 - Huy thi tra ve duyet set @uid = case when @xstatus = 1 then @@userId else 0 end set @dduyet = case when @xstatus = 1 then getdate() else null end
update m82 set status = @deststatus, user_id_duyet = @uid, ngay_duyet = @dduyet where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update d82 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
update cthu20 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys) and ma_ct = 'PU1' exec dbo.st_TongHopQuy
select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case when @xstatus = 1 then 9 else 5 end
update m82 set status = @deststatus, ly_do_huy = @ly_do_huy where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update d82 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys) exec dbo.st_TongHopQuy delete from cthu20 where id in (select id from @tblKeys) and ma_ct = 'PU1' select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
&VoucherJSLoading;
